name: length_myRev
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem length_myRev (xs : List α) : (myRev xs).length = xs.length
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, ih]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [myRev, List.length_append, ih, List.length_cons, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
